title: Parity knots among stitched copies
claim: Definitional facts proved by hand (with the advisor model): a flip-blind parity knot forbids all-equal copies; all-parity arrangements are Ledrappier's law on place differences. Exact: 8 of 45 harmonies (period <= 16) have a flip-blind triple, all of subspace dimension 2; with some but not all knots parity, states survive in 2.8% of placements on 3 x 3 and 0.16% on 4 x 4 (every placement), 0.34% of samples on 6 x 6 and none on 8 x 8; where they survive, count 0 fixes counts local propagation does not reach (69 of 114 and 806 of 850 survivors), full fixing in 24 and 646. After the run: no flip-blind triple is a stitch triple; survivors mostly surround whole copies with parity knots. Referee pending.
failure_conditions: No placement with 1 <= k < nm on 3 x 3 or 4 x 4 has a count fixed by count 0 but not reached by propagation.
remaining_obligations: Independent referee (the background referee thread): pending.
foundation_claim_scope: The plain not-all-equal law with flip-blind parity knots (A78); 45 harmonies of period <= 16; copies along two shifts on 3 x 3 and 4 x 4 (every placement) and 6 x 6 and 8 x 8 (uniform samples); the mixed knot shape.
